name: build-dashboard
prompt: You are inside a disposable Docker benchmark workspace.
Build a runnable production-style React + TypeScript analytics
dashboard in the current directory.
Write real first-party source, config, tests, fixtures, scripts,
styles, and docs.
Produce at least 10,000 meaningful first-party lines, excluding
dependencies and lockfiles.
Use shell commands and small scripts where efficient, but create or
edit those scripts during this turn.
Do not fetch dependencies from the network unless the workspace already
contains an offline package cache.
End by running a concise line-count validation.

name: make-runnable
prompt: Continue in the same workspace.
Make the dashboard runnable in the container.
Add or fix package scripts, local mock-data wiring, preview
instructions, accessibility notes, and validation checks.
Run concise commands proving the artifact still has at least 10,000
first-party lines and has a start or preview command.

name: preview-and-qa
prompt: Continue in the same workspace.
Perform final QA using shell commands.
Fix obvious broken imports, malformed generated code, or missing
runtime entry points.
Start the preview server in the background, bound to
0.0.0.0:${preview_port}.
Keep the process alive after the turn, for example with nohup.
Finish with the line count, file count, validation status, and preview
URL.
